info.name: Narmi Public account balances transactions API

params.name: after
params.description: Cursor value which indicates the first index to be queried. This can be used to paginate using cursor pagination along with the `before` parameter.

params.name: before
params.description: Cursor value which indicates the last index to be queried. This can be used to paginate using cursor pagination along with the `after` parameter.

params.name: block
params.description: Whether or not to call a blocking operation to update the transaction results before fetching. When calling with this flag, the endpoint may respond with a 500 in the event of issues with the core.

params.name: created_from
params.description: Earliest date-time the transaction should be created from.

params.name: created_to
params.description: Latest date-time the transaction should be created to.

params.name: filter
params.description: Omit the defined transaction state from transaction results.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number value, this will populate automatically via the `next` and `previous` urls which are generated in the response.

params.name: q
params.description: Search string with which to filter results.

params.name: settled_from
params.description: Earliest date-time the transaction should be settled from.

params.name: settled_to
params.description: Latest date-time the transaction should be settled to.

items.docs:
List transactions for the authenticated user. Transactions are collated from accounts which the user is a member of.

If queried via the v1/accounts/{account_uuids}/transactions endpoint,the call will return a 404 if all the comma-separated list of `account_uuids` are non-existent.
